title: 2008 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: On circle \(O,\) points \(C\) and \(D\) are on the same side of diameter \(\overline{AB},\) \(\angle AOC = 30^\circ,\) and \(\angle DOB = 45^\circ.\) What is the ratio of the area of the smaller sector \(COD\) to the area of the circle?

solutions.text:
Since \(\angle AOC,\) \(\angle COD,\) and \(\angle DOB\) fill the straight angle over diameter \(\overline{AB},\) \[ \begin{aligned} \angle COD &= 180^\circ - 30^\circ - 45^\circ \\ &= 105^\circ. \end{aligned} \]

The sector’s share of the circle is \(\dfrac{105^\circ}{360^\circ} = \dfrac{7}{24}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: \(\angle AOC,\) \(\angle COD,\) and \(\angle DOB\) together make the straight angle \(\overline{AB}\)
A sector’s fraction of the circle is its central angle divided by \(360^\circ\)
